prompt:
Create one clean pixel-art reference atlas for the existing NPC085 afraid/thinking eyes. Use the single attached 2x2 image as the exact portrait identity, emotion, palette, spacing, eye-opening shape, and blink-phase reference. Preserve this NPC's exact visible face and hair/head silhouette, warm skin, small warm brown/amber irises, dark pupils and outline, and distinctive fearful brow/expression. Keep the same pixel scale and low-resolution sprite rendering.

Canvas: one seamless two-column by two-row sheet, without margin, gutters, labels, extra faces, text, or decoration. Preserve the reference canvas ratio 1024:560 and the cell ratio 64:35. Cell order: top-left open eyes looking LEFT; top-right open eyes looking RIGHT; bottom-left half-blink eyes looking LEFT; bottom-right half-blink eyes looking RIGHT.

Keep the source's upper and lower eyelid contours, aperture width/height, eye angle, and fearful brows unchanged in every cell. The only difference between left and right is a gentle roughly one-native-pixel horizontal shift of each compact iris and pupil inside the same opening. Retain the existing warm brown/amber iris hue and dark pupil/outline; do not recolor or enlarge them. Keep the half-blink gaze aligned with the open pose above. Do not widen the eyes or expose extra sclera; keep any visible sclera muted beige and no broader than source. Highlights remain tiny and restrained, matching existing warm flecks; avoid oversized or bright white glints/bands. Avoid altered expression, reshaped lids or brows, square/bar pupils, eyes looking vertically, face/hair redesign, smoothing, antialiasing, blur, or added content.
